ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The attached staircase diagram shows the first seven steps fully. Counting upward from the bottom, the black-colored steps among these visible steps are the 3rd and the 6th steps. This matches the rule that every third step is black, so the black steps are exactly the step numbers divisible by 3. Reasoning: Anita steps on each of the 2023 steps exactly once and alternates feet. If she starts with her right foot, then her right foot lands on the odd-numbered steps: 1, 3, 5, etc. If she starts with her left foot, then her right foot lands on the even-numbered steps: 2, 4, 6, etc. The black steps are multiples of 3 up to 2023. There are floor(2023/3) = 674 black steps total. The even black steps are multiples of 6, so there are floor(2023/6) = 337 of them. The odd black steps are 674 - 337 = 337. Thus, no matter which foot Anita starts with, her right foot lands on 337 black steps. Therefore the minimum is 337.

From the text, use that there are 2023 steps and Anita alternates feet, choosing her starting foot. If she starts with the right foot, her right foot lands on odd-numbered steps; if she starts with the left foot, her right foot lands on even-numbered steps. Count black steps among multiples of 3 up to 2023 by parity: there are floor(2023/3)=674 black steps total, and the even black steps are the multiples of 6, floor(2023/6)=337. The odd black steps are 674-337=337. Therefore either starting choice gives 337, so the minimum is 337.

method.method_draft: First describe the diagram: the first seven steps show a repeating pattern in which steps 3 and 6 are black, and step 7 begins the next cycle as a nonblack step. From the text, Anita steps on every step in order and alternates feet. Group the staircase into consecutive blocks of 6 steps: steps 1-6, 7-12, and so on. In each 6-step block, because black steps are positions 3 and 6 within the block, one black step has odd position and the other has even position. Since alternating feet means the right foot always takes either all odd-numbered or all even-numbered steps, Anita must put her right foot on exactly one black step in each complete block of 6, regardless of which foot she starts with. Now compute 2023=6·337+1. The 337 complete blocks contribute 337 right-foot black steps. The remaining single step is position 2023, congruent to 1 mod 6, which is not black, so it adds none. Thus the minimum is 337.

图像描述：图中能看到楼梯的前七级，从下往上数，第3级台阶涂成黑色，第6级台阶也涂成黑色；第7级开始下一组，但不是黑色。因此图像与题意“每第三步为黑色”一致，黑色台阶是第3、6、9、…级。

推理：Anita 按顺序每一级都踩一次，并且左右脚交替。如果她右脚先踩第1级，那么右脚踩所有奇数编号台阶；如果她左脚先踩第1级，那么右脚踩所有偶数编号台阶。把2023级台阶分成连续的6级一组：1–6，7–12，依此类推。每个6级组内，黑色台阶都在组内第3级和第6级：其中一个是奇数编号台阶，另一个是偶数编号台阶。所以无论右脚踩奇数级还是偶数级，每个完整的6级组中右脚都会踩到恰好1个黑色台阶。计算 2023 = 6×337 + 1，因此有337个完整的6级组，贡献337个右脚踩到的黑色台阶。剩下的1级是第2023级，2023 ≡ 1 (mod 6)，不是黑色台阶，不增加数量。所以最少数量为337。
